review_findings: maximize/restore shell validation could complete after the advertised three-second phase deadline because nested message waits used only the global work budget
new ShowWindowAsync maximize/restore side effects lacked a fresh launched-process ownership revalidation immediately before each post
restore acceptance compared only width and height, allowing a same-size wrong-position window to pass even though SW_RESTORE promises original size and position
ResizeAndCheck accepted requested dimensions before checking its 1.5-second deadline and did not scope nested shell-message waits or post-validation acceptance to the remaining resize phase budget

ResizeAndCheck read the child inventory and then called side-effecting SetWindowPos without revalidating the cached top-level HWND against the still-running launched process immediately before the post, allowing a recycled HWND to receive an unintended resize
repair: add scoped local message deadlines and cap SendMessageTimeoutW waits to the remaining show-state phase budget
cap show-state polling sleeps to the remaining phase budget
establish show-state deadlines before asynchronous show-state requests
repeat launched-process ownership plus visibility/enabled validation immediately before maximize and restore posts
recheck the show-state phase deadline after complete shell validation before accepting maximized or restored state
require the complete GetWindowRect screen-space outer rectangle to match the pre-maximize rectangle before accepting restored state
establish the resize phase deadline before SetWindowPos and apply ScopedMessageDeadline to resize containment/shell validation
reject requested resize geometry observed at or after the 1.5-second deadline and recheck the deadline after containment and shell validation
cap resize polling sleeps to RemainingDeadlineBudget so the advertised resize phase deadline cannot be exceeded by the polling loop
repeat launched-process ownership plus visibility/enabled validation immediately before each side-effecting SetWindowPos resize request after child-inventory inspection

portable_fixtures.scope: source-logic show-state deadline/side-effect-gate evidence only; not Win32 GUI evidence
source-logic exact restore-rectangle regression evidence only; demonstrates old same-size false pass and new exact-rectangle rejection; not Win32 GUI evidence
source-logic resize-deadline regression evidence only; reproduces late-geometry and late-validation false passes and remaining-phase budget capping; not Win32 GUI evidence
source-logic resize side-effect gate evidence only; reproduces the old post-after-ownership-change path and verifies the new immediate ownership gate prevents the post; not Win32 GUI evidence

research.applicability: SWP_ASYNCWINDOWPOS can post a resize request to the thread that owns the target HWND, so the harness must revalidate ownership immediately before that side effect and then positively bound completion
uTimeout bounds an individual cross-thread message wait; the remaining resize/show-state phase budget must cap nested message waits
asynchronous show-state requests require positive bounded completion checks
SW_RESTORE restores the original window size and position, so a same-size wrong-position result must not pass
screen-space left/top/right/bottom outer-window coordinates provide a directly measurable exact restore predicate
returns the creating thread and optional process identity for a specified HWND and returns zero for an invalid HWND; used with the retained process handle to fail closed before side effects

progression_rules: No completion from docs, stubs, test counts, or green compilation alone.
Research one dependency-ready gap, reproduce or specify a failure, then implement one bounded packet.
Keep native and independent acceptance gates; staged repairs are not auto-merged.
Record source SHA, commands, exits, versions, files, hashes, and deferred local checks.
For pull_request CI, distinguish source association from GitHub's synthetic integration merge and tested base when recording final integration evidence.
A post-write receipt head is pinned in PR metadata/checkpoint rather than creating an infinite evidence-only commit chain solely to self-embed its own SHA.
Do not shrink an earlier admitted native acceptance matrix without explicit approved scope change.
No second local scheduler, local process control, R0 execution, publication, release, merge, dependency, or graphics-API change from this packet.
Do not remove unresolved capability rows or catalogue gaps to make parity easier.
